international_aviation.summary: 海軍陸戰隊預定12月8日在高雄左營海灘一帶實施「聯合作戰計畫演練實彈射擊」。中科院研製的勁蜂一型攻擊型無人機將投入此次操演，由兩棲偵搜大隊偵二中隊操作。
international_aviation.headline_en: Marine Corps to Use Attack Drone in December Live-Fire Drill
international_aviation.summary_en: The Marine Corps plans to hold a joint operational plan live-fire exercise around Zuoying Beach in Kaohsiung on December 8. An attack drone known as 勁蜂一型, developed by 中科院, is scheduled to take part and be operated by the amphibious reconnaissance unit’s Second Reconnaissance Squadron.

international_aviation.headline: 芝加哥奧黑爾機場（ORD）航管人力不足，FAA一度暫停飛往當地的航班起飛
international_aviation.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）11月23日發布地面停飛通告，要求部分飛往芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（ORD）的航班暫留出發地。措施涵蓋美國及加拿大部分航管區，並非暫停所有從奧黑爾機場起飛的航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: FAA briefly holds Chicago O’Hare-bound flights over air traffic control staffing
international_aviation.summary_en: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a ground stop on November 23 for some flights bound for Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD). It covered departures from parts of the United States and Canada; it did not ground all flights departing O’Hare.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍撤回沖繩下地島機場使用申請，兩架MH-47G直升機改直接前往嘉手納基地
international_aviation.summary: 沖繩縣11月23日表示，美軍已撤回宮古島市下地島機場的使用申請。《沖繩時報》報導，下地島機場管理事務所接獲的通知內容為「不前往下地島，將前往嘉手納基地」。《琉球新報》報導，為美軍提供航務等支援的民間公司在當天下午4時左右，向機場管理事務所通知取消使用；該報刊出的照片說明顯示，美國陸軍 MH-47G 直升機於當天下午5時11分飛抵嘉手納基地。
international_aviation.headline_en: US Army withdraws filing to refuel two MH-47G helicopters at Okinawa's Shimojishima Airport (SHI); aircraft head to Kadena instead
international_aviation.summary_en: Okinawa Prefecture said on November 23 that the US military had withdrawn its application to use Shimojishima Airport (SHI) in Miyakojima. The Okinawa Times reported that the airport's management office was told the helicopters would not go to Shimojishima and would head to Kadena Air Base. According to the Ryukyu Shimpo, a private company that supports US military flight operations notified the airport office of the cancellation at around 4 p.m. that day; the newspaper's photo caption shows a US Army MH-47G arriving at Kadena Air Base at 5:11 p.m.
